name: Grid Row Edit Action
description: Icon button inside a grid row template that copies the current row's fields (via [this.FIELD] context references) into a separate edit-mode dataset to populate an edit form/popup.

editDataset.description: e.g. "DsFrmDetailsEntry", the dataset the edit form binds to.

copiedFields.description: List of field names copied from the row, e.g. ["ACOPNDET_DOC_FYCODE", "ACOPNDET_DOC_DOCTYPE"].
